purpose: Versioned evidence ledger for the 64K Laguna DFlash M=16 performance program. Do not compare fields across contracts or throughput units.

metric_definitions.completion_tok_s: completion tokens divided by timed decode wall time; this is the canonical 300+ gate.
metric_definitions.accepted_counter_tok_s: speculative accepted-token counter divided by wall time; report alongside completion_tok_s but never compare it directly with completion_tok_s.
metric_definitions.acceptance_rate: accepted draft tokens divided by draft tokens; a scenario-quality guard, not an optimization objective.

quality_policy.fixed_regression_prompt: Output hash must remain identical and acceptance must not regress from the recorded prompt baseline.
quality_policy.ordinary_conversation: Acceptance must be >= 0.70; approximately 0.80 is a healthy target. Do not change prompts or generation semantics to inflate acceptance.

canonical_runtime_contract.name: fd33368-full-comparison-ours-64k
canonical_runtime_contract.command: PYTHONPATH=$PWD $PY -m bfdiag.cli exec --socket $PWD/.bfdiag/bfd.sock --timeout-s 900 -c 'from bfdiag.workloads import run_historical_dflash_prefix_cache_m16; print(run_historical_dflash_prefix_cache_m16(engine, tokenizer))'

notes: warm round 0 (55.54 tok/s, 10.9% acceptance) is a known prefix-state anomaly and is excluded from the steady warm target.
This is the first 300+ gate: completion_tok_s >= 300 on the canonical contract.
The old ee8c88850e16 record has a broken git/environment fingerprint, so it is evidence only for output/contract recovery, not a formal bf diff peer.

vllm_reference.name: vLLM Laguna M=16 64K quick-brown warm-prefix reference
vllm_reference.comparability: The prompt differs from the canonical runtime contract. Use this as a kernel/quick-brown reference only. A runtime run with this exact prompt hash, prefix cache on, and both throughput units is required before claiming an end-to-end vLLM win.

gates.first_performance_gate: completion_tok_s >= 300 on canonical_runtime_contract with output and quality gates passing
gates.vllm_win_gate: completion_tok_s >= 330 on the exact quick-brown vLLM contract with output/quality gates passing; 330 is >12.5% above the recorded vLLM best completion throughput of 293.06
gates.vllm_stretch_gate: completion_tok_s >= 350 on the exact quick-brown vLLM contract with output/quality gates passing; 350 is about 19.4% above the recorded vLLM best completion throughput of 293.06
gates.dflash_value_gate: On the exact runtime prompt and hot/cold state, runtime+DFlash must materially exceed runtime without DFlash; otherwise acceptance must not be used to claim a DFlash performance win.
